_comment: Scout sources. Every source ships DISABLED. Before enabling one: (1) read the site's terms of use - many job boards forbid automated collection; (2) prefer an official RSS/JSON feed or partner API where one exists; (3) Scout always honours robots.txt and waits between requests. types: rss | atom | jsonfeed | html-links. tier follows the MUSA trust hierarchy (0 = government ... 5 = social). Nothing Scout ingests is marked verified - a human does that in /admin.
